question: Was Olivier Lambert's refusal of Lina Haddad's parental leave request lawful?
expected_answer: Unlawful. Parental leave is a right; the employer may only postpone it (max 6 months) for justified reasons linked to the functioning of the company, notified in writing within one month of the request (RD 29/10/1997; leave policy v2). Olivier relied on the 2022 policy (superseded on 01/02/2025), refused instead of postponing, answered after 41 days and is not competent (HR only). The formal defect (plain e-mail instead of registered letter / signed duplicate) is weak because HR acknowledged receipt in writing. The HR Director correctly withdrew the refusal; the 3-week shift of the start was agreed. Lina is protected against dismissal.
key_facts: Request 10/03/2026 by e-mail, acknowledged by HR 11/03 (EML-Q04-01, EML-Q04-02, REC-Q04-01)
HR Director overrules 28/04; leave from 01/06/2026 (EML-Q04-04, INV-Q04-01, CTR-E1071-AMD-PARENTAL)

conflicts.issue: Can management refuse parental leave in peak periods?

sides.POL-LEAVE-v2-2025: no, only postpone ≤6 months within 1 month
sides.RD-BE-1997-PARENTAL-FR: right to parental leave; postponement conditions

conflicts.why: Law ranks first; v1 is superseded.

conflicts.resolution: Receipt is established; employer cannot rely on the form defect.
conflicts.why: Written acknowledgement serves the purpose of proof.
